reviews.text: so glad i picked up Cream Bebe and Cream Beans! (I <3 you, wonhee~) Cream Bebe is a gorgeous peachy pink color. It’s not as milky as the other shades in this collection (cream shell - cream haze). While I’ve noticed settling into the lip lines with the paler shades, Cream Bebe and Cream Beans do NOT, which is amazing. These two shades are more like the og color glosses.
reviews.zh: 好開心買咗 Cream Bebe 同 Cream Beans！（I <3 you, wonhee~）Cream Bebe 係超靚嘅桃粉色。冇呢個系列其他色號（cream shell - cream haze）咁奶。我留意到淺色嘅色號會卡喺唇紋，但 Cream Bebe 同 Cream Beans 唔會，超正。呢兩個色號比較似原版嘅 color gloss。

reviews.text: The colour is really pretty but the tint settles in your lip lines
reviews.zh: 顏色真係好靚，但染唇液會卡喺唇紋

reviews.text:
Foundation Color: Colourpop 120W
This lip gloss is super light, so i feel like it can work for many people. Not super sticky, but not quite like an oil. Photo 1 is Peony Ballet, vid is Peach Sparkle. If i were to pick only one, i'd go peach sparkle because the sparkle is THERE! My lips look like fairies kissed them. Both lip glosses have a slight tingle to them as well.
reviews.zh:
Foundation Color: Colourpop 120W
呢支唇釉超輕，覺得好似好多人都啱用。唔算超黐，但亦唔似油。相 1 係 Peony Ballet，片係 Peach Sparkle。如果只可以揀一支，我會揀 peach sparkle，因為閃粉勁正！我嘅嘴唇好似畀仙女 kiss 過。兩支唇釉都有少少刺感。

reviews.text: The gloss is exactly how it is in the photos! It’s so shimmery and pretty! I love the color grapy way, it’s perfect for cool tone people! With a layer of the Juicy lasting tint (bare fig) under it, it’s such a pretty match! Though, when I wipe it, it doesn’t stain. (Which is okay because it’s not advertised to do so.)
reviews.zh: 呢支唇釉同相入面一模一樣！超閃超靚！我好鍾意 grapy way 呢個顏色，冷調肌嘅人啱用！底層搽一層 Juicy lasting tint（bare fig）再上面，成個配搭超靚！不過抹走嘅時候唔會染色。（OK嘅，因為本來就冇標榜會染色。）

reviews.text:
I think that this gloss is like the average lip gloss tbh!
4 stars because it’s a good formula, but definitely the normal sticky lip gloss. 
I was very excited because everyone was saying that this formula was revolutionary etc…
It’s nice and smooth, but not mind-shattering 😅 I think this type of formula is common in the west.

The colors are definitely very pretty tho, I own shade 01 and 06 and love them both. I will say that shade 01 is darker than expected and 06 is redder than I thought.
Regardless, 01 is a dainty pink shade and 06 is a nice chocolate shade that I’m excited to use in the fall as an MLBB color. 
The color is quite sheer, it lasts as long as a normal lip gloss does. It does tint the lips tho which I like a lot!!!

These are swatches I found online that I think are quite accurate to irl.

Hope this is helpful~~
reviews.zh:
講真我覺得呢支唇釉好似一般嘅唇釉！
4 星因為質地唔錯，但絕對係正常嗰種黐立立嘅唇釉。
我本來好興奮，因為人人都話呢個質地好劃時代等等……
佢係滑嘅，但未至於勁到爆 😅 我覺得呢種質地喺西方好常見。

不過顏色真係好靚，我擁有 01 同 06 兩個色號，都好鍾意。要講嘅係 01 號比預期深色，06 號比我想像中紅。
無論如何，01 號係一種優雅嘅粉紅色，06 號係好正嘅朱古力色，我好期待秋天當 MLBB 色用。
顏色幾通透，持久度同一般唇釉一樣。不過佢真係會染唇，我好鍾意！！！

呢啲係我上網搵到嘅試色，我覺得幾乎同現實一樣準。

希望幫到大家～～

reviews.text: Peont Ballet is a very light pink color, perfect for everyday wear. It's very glossy but **not sticky!!!** which I feel is incredibly important for lip products. Compared to other romand lippies its noticeably much thicker yet more transparent and glassy. It lasts quite a while on my lips and creates a very natural yet put together and gorgeous look! I'll use it well ^^
reviews.zh: Peont Ballet 係非常淺嘅粉紅色，啱晒日常用。好有光澤但**唔黐！！！**我覺得呢一點對唇部產品嚟講好重要。相比其他 romand 唇彩，佢明顯更杰但更通透、更有玻璃感。喺我嘴唇上 keep 到一段時間，妝效好自然但又企理同靚！我會好好用佢 ^^

reviews.text: This reminds me of the Tower 28 lip jelly, so if you like those you’ll probably like this lip gloss. It doesn’t leave a stain, which I expected because it is quite glossy. It is sticky, so watch out when it’s windy... It smells faintly of apples.
reviews.zh: 呢支令我想起 Tower 28 嘅 lip jelly，所以如果你鍾意嗰啲，你可能都會鍾意呢支唇釉。佢唔會染色，因為佢好有光澤所以我有預到。佢係黐嘅，所以大風嘅時候要小心...有少少蘋果味。

reviews.text:
Deepen Moor (bottom swatch) is a super pretty rosy beige. It was a bit intimidating since it looked very dark on the bottle, but in real life it's so nice. The formula is crazy, it starts out creamy similar to the juicy tints, but then it starts to melt on your lips. Kind of like a lip oil. It really is a gorgeous gloss that doesn't emphasize your lip texture. It's slightly less pigmented than the Juicy tints, but wayy more glossy. It doesn't really smell like anything, maybe a bit like vaseline but no fragrance. Gorgeous when worn alone, but can also be topped over other tints for a slight rosy brown expression added. 

Surprisingly long lasting for a gloss btw. I'd argue the shine lasts longer than the juicy tints even after eating. I recommend!
reviews.zh:
Deepen Moor（下面嘅試色）係超靚嘅玫瑰米色。因為支樽望落好深所以有少少嚇親，但現實中睇好好睇。質地好神奇，一開始好似 juicy tints 咁 creamy，但之後就會開始喺嘴唇上融化。有少少似唇油。佢真係一支好靚嘅唇釉，唔會凸顯你嘅唇紋。顯色度比 Juicy tints 稍為低，但光澤感多好多。基本上冇乜味，可能有少少似凡士林但冇香料。單獨用已經好靚，但都可以疊喺其他染唇上面，加少少玫瑰棕色嘅感覺。

順帶一提，唇釉嚟講持久度令人驚喜。我會話食完嘢之後光澤仲keep得比 juicy tints 耐。推薦！
